description: This file contains unit tests for the Location class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing hierarchical location retrieval and descendant location filtering.

classes.name: LocationTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing Location hierarchy and descendant retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: isInHierarchy_shouldShouldFindLocationInHierarchy
methods.description: Tests whether the Location.isInHierarchy method correctly identifies a location within its hierarchy.

methods.name: getDescendantLocations_shouldReturnAllDescendantLocationsIfIncludeRetiredIsTrue
methods.description: Verifies that getDescendantLocations returns all descendants, including retired locations, when the parameter is true.

methods.name: getDescendantLocations_shouldReturnNonRetiredDescendantLocationsIfIncludeRetiredIsFalse
methods.description: Verifies that getDescendantLocations returns only non-retired descendants when the parameter is false.
